note: Synthetic example. Names and node IDs are illustrative. Times only; no date was given.

messages.author: Aarne Koskela
messages.text:
Morning Helmi, I'm at the TRN-117 site now. Swapped the SFP on the transmission node.
Link is up and alarms cleared, but the traffic counters are still at zero. Have you seen this before?

messages.author: Helmi Virtanen
messages.text: Morning. How is the optical level on the new module?

messages.author: Aarne Koskela
messages.text: Normal, receive level is in range, same as the old one.

messages.author: Helmi Virtanen
messages.text: Then it sounds like the older units. After a module swap they sometimes keep the old forwarding state and don't pass traffic even though everything looks fine. Is this one from the 2019 batch?

messages.author: Aarne Koskela
messages.text: Yes, 2019. Controller card revision A according to the sticker.

messages.author: Helmi Virtanen
messages.text: Reset the interface on both ends, shut and no shut, that should rebuild it. Don't do that on the newer controller revisions though, they behave differently.

messages.author: Aarne Koskela
messages.text: Ok, doing the reset now, far end first.

messages.author: Helmi Virtanen
messages.text: Go for it. Coffee after? Also your depot car park was full again yesterday, I had to leave the van on the street.

messages.author: Aarne Koskela
messages.text: Reset done on both ends. Traffic is passing again, counters are moving.

messages.author: Helmi Virtanen
messages.text: Good. I'll put it in the handover note.

messages.author: Aarne Koskela
messages.text: Thanks, heading to the next site.
